evidence.reason: pending() parses result.json with json.loads at line 669 without catching JSONDecodeError/OSError. A malformed existing result therefore raises on the admission/priority path before per-item exception handling, so one bad artifact can stop the drain. This is an ordinary implementation defect: the malformed result should be handled per job, preserved for harvest, and not treated as an absent result that authorizes rerunning the fixer. No contract clause is needed for this routine correctness repair.
